raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: psycopg
  version: "3.3.7"

recipe:
  name: psycopg-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/p/psycopg/psycopg-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 6574f23fd79bf129ee0616b49f6e358faf7ae1bf3a362d2ad599cf8f9c3d4935
    target_directory: psycopg
    patches:
      - 0001-remove-tzdata-for-pip-check.patch
  - url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/p/psycopg-c/psycopg_c-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: cf63d929860ce5203a86d9e3089a516c399bb32d621d3c0f210044a1d46054a1
    target_directory: psycopg-c

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  - package:
      name: psycopg-c
    build:
      script: cd psycopg-c && ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv  --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: 
          - python
          - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
          - postgresql
      host:
        - python
        - pip
        # conda-forge didn't build 80.3.1, so pin the lowest available higher version
        - setuptools ==83.0.0
        - wheel >=0.37
        - libpq
      run:
        - python
        - libpq
    tests:
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pip
        script:
          - pip check
  - package:
      name: psycopg
    build:
      # NOTE: must be kept equal to python_min
      skip: not linux64 or match(python, "!=3.10")
      noarch: python
      script: cd psycopg && ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - setuptools >=80.3.1
        - wheel >=0.37
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('psycopg-c', upper_bound='x.x.x.x.x.x') }}
        # tightest of upstream's floors (python <3.13)
        # for python <3.13 but keeping it for all to stay noarch: python
        - typing_extensions >=4.6
        - if: win
          then: python-tzdata
        - libpq
        # skipping tzdata based on https://github.com/conda-forge/psycopg2-feedstock/pull/120
        # so we don't have to build separately for windows
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - psycopg
            - psycopg.pq
            - psycopg_c
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}
            - "*"

about:
  summary: PostgreSQL database adapter for Python
  description: |
    Psycopg 3 is a newly designed PostgreSQL database adapter for the Python
    programming language. Psycopg 3 presents a familiar interface for everyone
    who has used Psycopg 2 or any other DB-API 2.0 database adapter, but allows
    to use more modern PostgreSQL and Python features.
  license: LGPL-3.0-only
  license_file: psycopg/LICENSE.txt
  homepage: https://psycopg.org/psycopg3/
  repository: https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/
  documentation: https://www.psycopg.org/psycopg3/docs/

extra:
